metadata.teaserText: Oracle has announced security updates for 17 November 2026, including eleven security patches for Java SE. According to the vendor, the associated vulnerabilities can be exploited over a network without credentials. The National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) recommends that operators check their systems and prepare to update them.

properties.text: Oracle has announced security updates for 17 November 2026, including eleven security patches for Java SE. According to the vendor, the associated vulnerabilities can be exploited over a network without credentials. The National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) recommends that operators check their systems and prepare to update them.

Java provides a technical foundation for many applications. It can also be included in software and devices without users being aware of it. The announcement covers GraalVM and JavaFX as well as Java SE. Details of the individual vulnerabilities and their remediation are expected with the full security advisory.

listItems.text:
Check your inventory:
Identify applications and devices that use Java, the versions in use and the responsible operators. Include embedded components and externally managed services.

Prepare to update:
Contact your software suppliers and IT service providers to establish which products are affected and how updates will be provided. Prepare for prompt installation, including the necessary tests and restarts.

Review access:
Prioritise internet-facing and business-critical systems. Restrict unnecessary external access.

properties.text: For individuals, the priority is to install available security updates for their software and devices. Use the official update functions and follow the providers’ guidance. Depending on the product, embedded Java components are updated through a software or device update.
Anyone operating their own servers or online services should also follow the recommendations for operators.
The NCSC is adding technical information to the Cyber Security Hub. For affected products, refer to the security information from Oracle and the respective providers.
